Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `starry` (Epic eye), 28 x 14 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Aurora. VFX: kept on the body (Epic, Effects.luau): a mint aurora trail waves off its
crest back to its tail (the Trail from Top to Tail), violet motes rise off the crest at 4 a
second (the Emitter at Top), a mint light on the crest pulses every 3 s, every 6 s it purrs in
colours, a burst of twelve pink twinkles off the crest (the flourish Burst at Top), and a
catchlight winks in its eyes every 5 s (the Sparkle at Eyes); the crest, the ear tufts and the
tail tip glow and step through violet, mint and pink every 6 s (the glow cycle); it bobs
gently; in the rig the crest ribbons wave, the ears flick, the whiskers twitch and the tail
sways, and every 12 s it hops into a full turn with the crest swished
